_comment: Single source of truth for NeOS's brand colors. Every consuming file (QML, QSS, SVG, Python, KDE .colors, os-release) keeps its own literal hex copy of these values — see tests/verify_palette_consistency.sh, which asserts they all still match this file and that the old borrowed 'NTB' palette (#0088CF/#0096D5/#EB008B) is gone. If you change a value here, update every file tests/verify_palette_consistency.sh lists.
